title: Rank SR Legacy foods by one nutrient (April 2018)
purpose: Rank the SR Legacy foods in this FoodData Central release by their amount per 100 g of one nutrient, highest or lowest first, with each food's FDC id, NDB number, description, food category, the nutrient's name and unit and the amount. Foods without a published amount for the nutrient are left out. Ties order by description, then FDC id. Each food and nutrient pair has one amount in this release.

parameters.name: nutrient_id
parameters.description: Nutrient id in this release (fdc-sr-food-nutrients-2018-04 lists them, for example 1003 protein or 1162 vitamin C)

output_columns.name: fdc_id
output_columns.description: FoodData Central id of the food

output_columns.name: ndb_number
output_columns.description: NDB number of the SR Legacy food

output_columns.name: amount
output_columns.description: Amount per 100 g of the food, as published
